dedupe_keys.name: dataset of natech events triggered by lightning in the process industry to 2022

description: This dataset lists past industrial accidents in the process industry that were caused directly or indirectly by lightning strikes, a class of Natech (natural hazard triggered technological) events, with records up to the end of 2022. The Mendeley Data page says the events were compiled from open-source accident databases in Europe (ARIA, eMARS, TAD IChemE, eNATECH) and the United States (NRC, CSB), cross-checked with open literature, and classified by source of damage, damage state, final scenario, affected equipment and industrial macro-sector. It was published in December 2023 (version 3) by seven contributors under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one XLSX file of about 96 KB. Coverage is worldwide as far as the source databases report. Caveats: the author affiliation is not stated on the page read (the author list matches a Politecnico di Torino group only by inference), inclusion depends on what the source databases captured, and the sample is small. For simulation it gives conditional frequencies of equipment damage and final scenarios given a lightning strike, for Natech fragility and event-tree models of process plants. Related catalogue records include eNATECH, eMARS, the ARIA database and the US CSB investigations.
